text:
ana (PM): ok team — time to lock the hosted api priorities for the next quarter. i sketched a prio matrix that tries to balance customer asks, platform bets, and OKR impact. want quick alignment so we can publish by EOD friday.
kevin (eng): +1. can we call out latency vs cost tradeoffs explicitly? rerank and low-latency embeddings are the main tradeoff i see.
maria (prod ops): also need to include rollout criteria (canary %, health thresholds) and an automatic fallback plan for model failures. last time we had partial outages this saved a lot.
devon (solutions): customers are asking three things: 1) embed latency SLA for search, 2) predictably low tail latency for chat, 3) rerank endpoint with lower p99. i'm pushing for embeddings SLA to be top.
sam (evals): if embeddings SLA moves up, we need rigorous quality guards — can't just quantize without regression evals. propose a small eval suite per customer cohort.
lisa (design): UX ask — we should expose a simple toggle in Console for "priority latency" vs "cost saver" so customers can choose. small telemetry change but big UX value.
olivia (infra): capacity-wise, embeddings SLA at scale means reserved pools or burst guarantees. that impacts Dedicated product and cost math. need a knobs doc for ops.
nana (ana): (typo) olivia — noted. my thinking: split roadmap into 3 lanes: customer-driven (embeddings SLA, rerank p99), platform bets (auto-batching + KV-caching improvements), and ops/rollout (canary + fallback tooling).
kevin (eng): agree. quick sketch of prio matrix:
```
prio,impact,effort,okrs
embeddings-sla,high,medium,reduce-search-latency
rerank-low-p99,high,high,increase-rerank-throughput
auto-batching,medium,medium,lower-token-cost
canary-fallback,medium,low,improve-availability
streaming-stability,low,medium,better-stream-reliability
```
kevin (eng): note rerank low p99 is high effort because models + infra + cache invalidation.
devon (solutions): customers will accept phased delivery. embeddings SLA MVP can be: guaranteed regional capacity + predictive batching. then follow-up with stricter p99.
sam (evals): for embeddings SLA MVP we should ship with a baseline eval and daily regression alert. i'll own the eval harness.
lisa (design): console toggle mockups ready — i'll drop them in Figma and link. small docs change + tooltip copy.
maria (prod ops): rollout playbook: canary to 5% for 6 hours, monitor token latency, p95/p99, error rate; if p99 > target rollback. also add a cheat sheet for SEs.
olivia (infra): cost estimate incoming — if we reserve GPUs for embeddings peak, monthly committed cost rises ~X%. will post draft.
nana (ana): action items:
- kevin: tech spec for rerank + cost estimate (due Tue)
- olivia: committed capacity cost math (due Wed)
- sam: eval suite and baseline metrics (due Tue)
- lisa: console toggle mock + copy (due Thu)
- maria: rollout playbook + SE cheat sheet (due Thu)
- devon: summarize top 5 customer asks with priority weightings (due Mon)
please add if i missed anything.
kevin (eng): putting spec PR up shortly.
deploy-bot: deploy started: hosted-api/prio-matrix/spec-v0 -> staging :rocket:
nana (ana): thanks all. let's reconvene Friday 10am PT to finalize commit. :thumbsup:
